noun_definition: mweb refers to the web version of the application that is being compared to the Android app in terms of its functionality for creating a new workspace.
workpace refers to a feature in the mweb and Android app that allows users to create a new workspace by tapping a plus icon.

Workspace refers to a designated area or environment within the application where users can create and manage their projects or tasks, as indicated by the action of tapping the plus icon to create a new workspace.
Plus icon refers to the graphical element used in the mweb and Android app to initiate the creation of a new workspace.
Behavior refers to the differing responses or actions exhibited by the mweb and Android app when attempting to create a new workspace using the plus icon.
android refers to the mobile application version of the software that is being compared to the mweb version in terms of workspace creation behavior.
